QuestInfo.name: Chiefs of El Nath
QuestInfo.0: You heard that mysterious voice again. Find the Dark Lord, the Thief Job Instructor, and see what advice he has.
QuestInfo.1: The Dark Lord sent you to the Chief's Residence in El Nath to become an even stronger Thief.
QuestInfo.2: You met with Arec, the Thief Elder, at the Chief's Residence.
